role: Vice Chairman of State Highway Commission
stance_basis: introduced hearing and provided procedural information with no position stated on the project
summary: B. O. Pinney, Vice Chairman of the State Highway Commission, appeared as the first witness at the March 25, 1969 Corridor Location Public Hearing. His role was purely procedural: he introduced the Division of Highways representative, explained the hearing's purpose and procedures, and noted the availability of relocation assistance information. No response was deemed necessary by the agency.
complaint_summary: B. O. Pinney introduced the Division of Highways representative, explained the hearing's reasons and procedures, and noted that relocation assistance information was available for displaced individuals and businesses.
summary_quote: Introduced representative from The Division of Highways. Gave reasons for the hearing as well as the procedure to be followed during the hearing. Stated that information was available on relocation assistance for individuals and businesses displaced by the proposed highway improvement.
